WITH member_totals AS (
    SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM income
    GROUP BY link_to_member
), shares AS (
    SELECT total_amount,
           1.0 * total_amount / SUM(total_amount) OVER () AS share
    FROM member_totals
), above_average AS (
    SELECT total_amount, share
    FROM shares
    WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
)
SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS combined_amount,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: Members are the distinct link_to_member values that have income rows; income without a member link is grouped as its own NULL group. Shares use the sum of those member totals as the denominator.
